preconditions.description: The length of the array arr is between 1 and 1000.
Each string in the array arr has a length between 1 and 30.

postconditions.description: If there exists a string that satisfies the conditions, the function returns that string. Otherwise, it returns an empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(s in arr for s in return_value) and all(s in arr for s in return_value[:i+1] for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The returned string is lexicographically smallest among all strings that satisfy the conditions, and all of its prefixes are also present in the array.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max(len(s) for s in arr if all(s in arr for s in s[:i+1] for i in range(len(s))))
postconditions.description: The returned string is the longest among all strings that satisfy the conditions.
